content: I don't think there have been any announcement here, but there will be two events about teaching using a proof assistant, and Lean in particular: https://sites.google.com/view/learning-maths-with-lean2/ and https://pat2023.icube.unistra.fr/. Discussion related to these events should happen at https://leanprover.zulipchat.com/#narrow/stream/187764-Lean-for-teaching/topic/Two.20workshops/near/339895659.2E01 to avoid cluttering this stream.
